description: Show the best Generalist reference photo on screen in the design gallery for live comparison. Jake (voice): 'Put somewhere on the screen the actual photos you have of the Generalist one, from the top angle, the best photo that shows the design well. Because it's the same all the way down, a top angle would be best. I'd like to see that in there so we can compare it live.' Ask: in the Helping Hands design gallery/viewer, when viewing a Generalist-copy gripper (Gen 6, 7, 9, 10, 11...), show a reference photo panel on screen next to the 3D model. Default to the best top-down profile shot (cad/reference/generalist_gripper_gen6_two_hands.png is the clearest full finger profile; _top.png is the alternative; pick whichever shows the shape best), and let him swap to the other reference photos. It must work on the phone layout too.

results.notes: Jake (voice): 'I also want the ability to auto-align the images. It should rotate all the models and align them, especially to the top-down view, but it makes sense to build the other views as well. It should align all of the ones on the screen, and that photo of the actual we're working from should be there too.' Add: view-preset buttons (Top first, plus Front, Side and Iso) that snap EVERY model on screen to the same camera angle and scale at once, so they line up for comparison. The Top preset should match the Actual photo's viewpoint so the models and the photo line up side by side. .

Jake (voice): 'What I want you to focus on right now is bringing in the actual photo we have from Generalist. I'm just going to look at Gen 9, 10 and 11. Add the photo there. Maybe make that photo show up as the actual.' Clarified ask, top priority: add the Generalist reference photo to the gallery comparison as its own entry labeled 'Actual (Generalist)', shown alongside Gen 9, 10 and 11 the same way the designs are, so he can compare live. Default photo: the best top-down profile (generalist_gripper_gen6_two_hands.png or _top.png, whichever shows the finger shape best, cropped to one gripper if that helps), with the other reference photos selectable. Do not change any existing generation. .

summary: The design gallery needs the Generalist reference photo added as an "Actual (Generalist)" entry beside Gen 9, 10 and 11. It also needs Top, Front, Side and Iso preset buttons that snap every model to the same camera angle, with Top matching the photo.
